Change in Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (“MD & CEO”) of the Bank
In continuation to our earlier intimations on the captioned subject, this is to inform that
Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan has vacated the office as the MD & CEO of the Bank from the close of business
hours on October 26, 2026 on account of completion of his tenure and Mr. Anup Bagchi has assumed charge
as MD & CEO of the Bank effective today i.e. October 27, 2026.

commitment demonstrated by Mr. Jagdishan throughout his distinguished tenure. His stewardship has been
instrumental in strengthening the Bank’s performance, culture, and customer‑centric approach. The Bank
also acknowledges his pivotal role in steering the successful completion of one of the largest mergers in
corporate India. The Bank expresses its profound gratitude for his exemplary service and long association
with the Bank over so many decades.
The Bank warmly welcomes Mr. Anup Bagchi to his new role and looks forward to his leadership in
advancing the Bank’s strategic priorities.
